register_instance: RC6 (docs/operations/problem-register.md, WP6.1 and RC1 WP1.2 Human Inbox detail targeted contributor reads)
defect: During hosted crawl on Root 45740904149 (BFF 8e67d240e034 + FE 38e5337d1f83), GET /bff/management/human-inbox/readiness_blocker:persona:persona-tw-equity returned HTTP 503 (precondition_failed: 'human_inbox_partial_read', 2097 ms) instead of HTTP 404 because ManagementService.get_human_inbox_detail_result unconditionally fanned out across all five Human Inbox contributors (approval_queue, governance_review_queue, incidents, persona_readiness, meetings) and failed closed on unrelated contributor timeouts/degradation.

fix.prefix_typed_detail_scoping: Map unambiguous prefix-typed item_id values (readiness_blocker:* -> persona_readiness; incident:* -> incidents; meeting:* / meeting_review:* / meeting_refusal:* / meeting_proposal:* / meeting_action:* -> meetings; approval:* -> approval_queue + governance_review_queue; governance_review:* -> governance_review_queue + approval_queue) in _human_inbox_contributors_for_item_id and _human_inbox_source_type_for_item_id so get_human_inbox_detail_result executes only the contributor reader(s) and prewarm reads capable of producing the requested item.
fix.source_type_scoping: Map explicit source_type filters in _human_inbox_contributors_for_source_type so get_human_inbox, get_hiq_backlog, and _get_human_inbox_degraded_payload execute and track only the matching contributor reader subset when source_type restricts to known contributor surfaces.
fix.honest_404_and_fail_closed_503: When all contributors in a typed item_id's required subset succeed with no match, get_human_inbox_detail_result returns (None, []) -> HTTP 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND even if unqueried contributors would time out or fail. When any contributor in the required subset (or any contributor for an untyped/ambiguous item_id) fails or times out without a match, preserve fail-closed HTTP 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE (precondition_failed='human_inbox_partial_read').

runtime_budget.downstream_calls_per_typed_detail_read: reduced from 5 contributors to 1-2 contributors (1 for readiness_blocker:*, incident:*, meeting:*; 2 for approval:*, governance_review:*)

tests.services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_hu: 3 new tests covering readiness_blocker:persona:persona-tw-equity returning 404 while meetings/incidents/approvals/governance_review_queue raise TimeoutError (0 calls to unrelated contributors), readiness_blocker:* returning 503 human_inbox_partial_read when persona_readiness itself degrades, all five prefix families (readiness_blocker:*, incident:*, meeting:*, approval:*, governance_review:*) scoping to 1-2 contributors, untyped item_id preserving full-contributor fail-closed 503, and found-item detail shape parity between typed and untyped IDs.
tests.services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_ma: test_human_inbox_detail_targeted_contributor_scoping_and_source_type_reads verifying router-mounted 404/503 semantics and source_type=readiness_blocker contributor isolation alongside existing 45 router tests.
